message: 🎯 Comprehensive wellness plan delivered based on your input: test message...

meditation.title: Take a 10-minute meditation break before sleep
meditation.benefits: Reduces stress, improves sleep quality, prepares mind for tomorrow's challenges, enhances recovery
meditation.instructions: Find a quiet space, sit comfortably, and follow the guided meditation video. Focus on deep breathing and letting go of the day's stress.
meditation.environment: Dim lights, comfortable seating, minimal distractions
meditation.expected_outcomes: Better sleep quality, reduced anxiety, improved morning energy

workout.title: Energy-conserving morning workout before your long work day
workout.intensity: Moderate - designed to energize without exhausting
workout.focus: Energy preservation, stress relief, and work preparation
workout.rationale: Light exercise in the morning boosts energy and mood for the work day without depleting reserves

warm_up.purpose: Increase blood flow and prepare muscles

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.notes: Focus on form, not intensity. Keep it light to preserve energy.
exercises.benefits: Activates major muscle groups, boosts metabolism

exercises.name: Push-ups (modified if needed)
exercises.notes: Use knee push-ups if needed. Keep energy for work day.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Core stability without exhaustion. Focus on form.

exercises.name: Light Stretching Sequence
exercises.notes: Focus on mobility and relaxation. Perfect for work preparation.
exercises.benefits: Improved flexibility, stress reduction, better posture for work

cool_down.purpose: Recovery and mental preparation for the day ahead

post_workout_nutrition.purpose: Replenish energy stores without heavy digestion

dinner.title: Enjoy your wellness journey without calorie worries
dinner.reason: You will expend significant energy during your wellness activities
dinner.advice: Focus on the journey and quality time with yourself
dinner.guidance: The combination of morning workout and wellness activities will create a significant calorie deficit, allowing you to enjoy your meals guilt-free

calorie_math.conclusion: Plenty of room for balanced nutrition

celebration_tips: Focus on the experience and mindfulness
dinner.mental_approach: This is a celebration of your wellness journey, not a diet day. The work you've done today has earned you this enjoyment.
